best_idea: Drive all ambient animation from one shared low-rate clock with each animation described as data (frames, ticks per frame, offset), pick the animated items once per change, and pause the ambient pass when the tab is hidden.
decision_why: Keep the shared clock, the per-animation data and the hidden-tab pause for water, waterfall and weather ambience; the canvas tile redraw does not apply to a 3D renderer, which needs the same clock on material frames instead.
acceptance: A zone with water and weather shows the same ambient frame index on every client at the same time, and a backgrounded tab does no ambient animation work until it returns to the foreground.
